boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 126 lines up horizontal Lego-textured bars with slide arrows, stacking them around twin orange-bordered `7` blocks and a bottom `9`/`11` counter row. The `7` pair must clear in sequence — breaking one without first opening the center channel leaves its twin orphaned with no exit lane. The bottom bar only starts counting down once both `7` blocks are gone.
landmarks: Block Out Level 126 lines up horizontal Lego-textured bars with slide arrows, stacking them around twin orange-bordered `7` blocks and a bottom `9`/`11` counter row.
The `7` pair must clear in sequence — breaking one without first opening the center channel leaves its twin orphaned with no exit lane.
The bottom bar only starts counting down once both `7` blocks are gone.

quickTips: The right orange-bordered `7` must go before the left one — reversing the order blocks the `9`/`11` bar.
Leave the center `4` tower alone until the top yellow/purple/green bar stack is fully cleared.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Slide the top pink `7` and cyan `8` blocks along the row arrows, then clear the yellow/purple/green bar stack on the left.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Break the center red/blue/cyan `4` tower without sealing the right red arrow lane.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Detach the left blue `2` and purple `4` column once the top bars are gone.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Pop both orange-bordered purple `7` blocks while the bottom cyan `13` and blue `15` counters are still reachable.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Spend the bottom light-blue `9` and `11` counter tiles to open the final lane.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Clear the purple `2` pair and finish through the cyan `4` and yellow `6` exit counters.

failurePoints: Clearing the left purple `7` before the right one — the `9`/`11` bar stays locked.
Touching the center `4` tower while the top yellow/purple/green bars are still in place.
